description: A Dental Clinic start-up in the Philippines, a landing page website built using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS. Deployed using Cloudflare Pages and backend server using Node.js and Cloudflare pages.

A personal portfolio website built using HTML, CSS, and Javascript. Deployed using Cloudflare Pages. It serves as a platform to showcase my skills, projects, and experiences as a Virtual Assistant and Web Developer. It has a front-end focus, and a simple backend using cloudflare pages handling email API.

A personal 2D Platformer Game project made in Unity using C# with custom made graphics made by a colleague. I didn't do the graphics but I programmed the game from the movements and over all the functionality of the game

A Dental Clinic start-up in the Philippines, I managed their Facebook page by creating content and posting regularly to engage with their audience and promote their services. I also handled marketing through facebook ads and their google business profile, ensuring a positive online presence for the clinic.

A 3D modeling and animation project for a bubble cutting machine prototype, showcasing the design and functionality of the machine. This is a prototype of a machine from engineering students in the Philippines, I created the 3D model and animation to visualize the machine's operation and design concept.
